mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 2100 thousand units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to a higher probability of Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in over 55% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.025 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 106.5 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 60d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 106.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand surge that increases inflation expectations and prompts aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60d returns in over 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 198.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 in any 2-year window.

failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered periods, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures combined with a rising GDP growth rate signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflationary pressure and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to momentum in cyclical equities.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 5d returns in more than 50% of non-triggered periods, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
